title: The Runner
plot_overview: During her morning run through London, a determined lawyer receives a call saying her young son has been kidnapped. To save him, she must follow a series of ruthless instructions while racing across the city, balancing a dangerous legal case against an urgent fight to protect her child.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like brisk, deadline-driven action thrillers such as Blacklight, but it may disappoint viewers seeking believable plotting or fresh ideas; Not for you if implausible twists quickly ruin the tension.
review_summary: Pros: fast-paced thrills; stylish London setting; urgent premise | Cons: predictable story; implausible developments; weak script
